build_cpp_ast_from_source: build an AST from C++ source code using BuilderFromSource and iterate over generated nodes
parse_cpp_file_identifiers: parse a C++ file and print all identifiers matching a predicate using PrintIndentifiers
parse_multiple_cpp_files: parse multiple C++ files and print identifiers matching a predicate using PrintAllIndentifiers
run_ast_builder_on_files: run the AST builder on C++ source files via the main entry point with sys.argv
review_ast_node_classes: review the Node subclasses like Class, Function, Method, Type, and Typedef for C++ AST representation
